Name: Pride Pastries
Author: acearohippo
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Overview: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]This has been on my mind for several months because while there are several pastry mods and quite a number of LGBT themed mods, no one that I could find thought to combine them? So, in honour of the Alphabet Mafia, I'm contributing pride-themed pastries to the Stardew Valley Community. I needed a break from the frustration of a mod I've been working on. I cranked this out in a little over a day so please bear with me and if there are any glaring issues or game-economy breaking buffs, post in the comments so I can fix it in an update! :D [/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Features: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left][list]
[*]6 types of fully cookable dishes:
[list=1]
[*]14 [u][color=#3d85c6]Jumbo Cookies[/color][/u]: I was in a rush to get this out before June ended and completely forgot that SDV already has cookies... So take these jumbo ones. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3WrXDMm.png[/img]
[*]14 [u][color=#3d85c6]Donuts[/color][/u]: Who doesn't love a fat donut? I don't, actually, I doNUT like donuts :'D But anyone who is old enough knows about the... allegory for donuts might appreciate this, so I couldn't not include them! 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/c2QWrOh.png[/img]
[*]14 [u][color=#3d85c6]Cheesecake[/color][/u]: Again, completely slipped my mind that SDV has, like, several cakes in-game that I could've just recoloured. Instead, get my best attempt at making cheesecakes! 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/o5TUxLu.png[/img]
[*]13 [u][color=#3d85c6]Waffle Cones[/color][/u]: There aren't enough ice cream mods.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ESv9CHu.png[/img]
[*]13 [u][color=#3d85c6]Smoothies[/color][/u]: One can never have too many fancy beverages.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jklmyU1.png[/img]
[*][b][color=#dd7e6b]NEW[/color][/b] 14 [u][color=#3d85c6]Waffles[/color][/u]: Because why not?
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5wuPP1w.png[/img]
[/list][/list]
[*]All pastries are available in 13 major pride flag colours: Agender, Aromantic, Asexual, Bisexual, Gay, Genderfluid, Genderqueer, Intersex, Lesbian, Nonbinary, Pansexual, Polyamory, and Transgender. Not included is Demisexual, because they use the same colours as the asexual flag and besides stamping a black triangle on the cookies, it was really difficult making any sort of visibly differing pastries when compared to it. So, my apologies to all y'all demisexuals out there :( You're not forgotten! An added apology to other specific identities, sexualities, and genders that were not featured. I chose the most well-known and official flags.
[*]4 Sweet Decoration types:
[list=1]
[*]8 Jars of [u][color=#3d85c6]Sprinkles[/color][/u]: To make the Agender, Aromantic, Asexual, Gay, Genderfluid, Lesbian, Nonbinary, and Transgender Pride cookies and donuts.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BpbxlIK.png[/img]
[*]8 Colourful [u][color=#3d85c6]Piped Icing[/color][/u]: To make the decorated (and buffed) Pride Cheesecakes and the rest of the cookies and donuts that don't use sprinkles.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0jaqim6.png[/img]
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Fruity Syrup[/color][/u]: A case of colourful syrups, to make the Waffle Cones.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kHYHIXd.png[/img]
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Canned Whipped Cream[/color][/u]: To make the smoothies.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vX0bkCu.png[/img]
[/list]
[*][b][color=#dd7e6b]NEW[/color][/b] [u][color=#3d85c6]Super Powered Sodas[/color][/u]. These sodas can either be crafted after buying the recipe from Dwarf or if you download Joja Cola Restock, purchased from the vending machine*. When drunk, they give extremely powerful buffs! Let the Power of the Alphabet Mafia course through you:
[list=1]
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]The Pride[/color][/u]:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pFOWTkI.gif[/img]
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Triple-A Game[/color][/u]:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fmuVDIA.gif[/img]
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Euphoria[/color][/u]:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9oIabgR.gif[/img]
[*][u][color=#3d85c6]Galaxy Brain[/color][/u]:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/99sYtaL.gif[/img]
[/list]
[*]All recipes can be purchased from Gus. Decorations can be purchased from Pierre.
*If you would like to have sodas show up in the Vending Machine (at the Saloon) respectively, you will need to download my compatibility patch for Joja Cola Restock in the optional download section. All recipes are purchasable and, thus, everything can be made and consumed withOUT these mods :D
[*]All cooked and crafted foods/beverages, except the [u][color=#3d85c6][s]Plain[/s] Cishet Cheesecake, [s]Jumbo[/s] Cishet Cookies, [s]Plain[/s] Cishet Donut, and [b][color=#dd7e6b]NEW[/color][/b] Pan-Sized Waffle[/color][/u] have buffs when eaten.
[*]All cooked foods are giftable! Gifting preferences are based on the FOOD item and NOT sexuality/identity/gender. So, all donuts will be loved, liked, etc by the same people, regardless of the "flavour".
[/list][/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Current Update: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
Renamed Jumbo Cookies, Plain Cheesecake, and Plain Donut to Cishet " " (name courtesy of Obamoose!) to hopefully prevent future duplicate item issues. All recipes have been changed to reflect this. 
If using Kitchen Station Set, you will have to manually rename those items to Cishet Cookies, Cishet Cheesecake, and Cishet Donut in order for them to show up in their menus.[/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Future Updates: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
Eventually, I will be converting to DGA, but that won't be for a while yet. Too busy atm to learn a new framework.[/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Requirements: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left][list]
[*]Json Assets
[*]Content Patcher Animation (and its required mods)
[*]Joja Cola Restock, optional
[*] Alex's Frozen Treats, optional
[*]Kitchen Station Set, optional
[/list][/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Install/Unistall: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
Extract zipped files and place content in your Mods folder. Can either keep my [Hippo] Pride Pastries folder as is or take out the [JA] and [CPA] folders and place it in your Mods folder. DO NOT take any files out of those folders! If anything warns you of "overwriting", you're extracting it wrong!

To install the content patch, you must replace the corresponding .json files for each mod in the exact location I tell you in the readme files!

To uninstall, simply make sure any objects are deleted from inventory, chests, and removed from the farm. Then delete my mod.[/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Mods I Recommend: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
This is usually the part where I post links to specific mods I've used that compliment either the aesthetic or essence of my mod, but seeing that it was Pride Month a couple of hours ago, I will instead link to all the current pride-themed mods for Stardew Valley regardless of whether I've used them or not :D Lots of pretty clothes, lovely Custom Furniture, and a few extra goodies to be found! :D

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9021]Lumisteria's Pride Banners[/url] by Lumisteria- Very GORGEOUS banners, my gosh.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9019]Prismatic Pride[/url] by kdau
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8429]Autistic Pride Flags[/url] by eorrl
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8276]LGBTQ Pride Flag for CF[/url] by eorrl
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8001]Pridematic Shard[/url] by Symtrkl- Pick and choose a prismatic shard recolour AND optionally rename it! :D
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6091]Colorful Tulip- Pride Edition[/url] by the legendary Kaya
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4426]Prideful Town[/url] by lyssaness- Seems to specifically target assets rather than replace all of {{season}}_townmap.png. Edits the dog house to with one of their own mods.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4148]Macrame Pride Wall Hangings for CF[/url] by Mycenia
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3701]LGBT Pride Shirts for Farmer[/url] by Mixter Moro- There seems to be a JA version of the mod. Might work with use of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] mod.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2352]LGBT Pride Flags Paintings[/url] by BananaBlaze187- Warning with this one, it is a CP mod and, from the surface, it looks like it's only targeting paintings rather than replacing the entire furniture.png.

And that's it! Well, there are 4 mods I did not list, Zee's Lgbt Shirts, Odgepodge's LGBT shirts, the CP converted, combined version of those mods by TheNewit13, and Pride Flags by xMarsMission. The reason for this is that 3 of those 4 mods are xnb replacer and extremely out of date, so they WILL damage your game if installed, and the CP mod is also very out of date and will cause visual errors on your farmer.[/left][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Mods in Pics: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[size=2][left]
Normally, I would list all the mods in my preview pictures, but seeing as I am making the focus about Pride, I don't want to detract from that so! If you see anything in the pics that you'd like to know about, don't hesitate to ask!
Happy Belated Pride![/left][/size][/font]
